svg.font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: reBot-DevArm assurance
svg.desc: The reBot Arm B601-DM v1.1, Seeed Studio's desktop robot arm, with its gripper raised, beside the title reBot-DevArm assurance: the safety-assurance record for a fork of the arm, following ISO 12100, ISO 10218-1 and -2, ISO/TS 15066, ISO 13849-1, EN 60204-1, IEC 62443, ISO/IEC TR 5469 and the Machinery Regulation. Image: Seeed Studio, reBot Arm B601-DM v1.1 (upstream media/v1.1_2.png), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The fork is not affiliated with or endorsed by Seeed Studio.
svg.text: The safety-assurance record for a fork of
Seeed Studio's open desktop robot arm
Image: Seeed Studio, reBot Arm B601-DM v1.1 (upstream media/v1.1_2.png), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The fork is not affiliated with or endorsed by Seeed Studio.
